data.title: Meghan ‘distressed’ by reports father had child-abuse images
data.description: LONDON - Prince Harry’s wife Meghan said on Friday she was “deeply distressed” by accusations that her father had images of child abuse, adding she had blocked contact between him and her children over previous “troubling and disturbing” allegations.

data.title: Gunman kills one, wounds four in town outside Paris
data.description: TRAPPES, France - A gunman firing from his car killed one person and wounded four in the Paris suburb of Trappes on Friday, authorities said, with at least two victims from immigrant backgrounds and prosecutors investigating the case as a potential “terrorist” act.

data.title: Tanker with Russian diesel heads to New York
data.description: A tanker filled with Russian diesel is headed for New York, maritime trackers and the Kremlin confirmed on Friday, after the United States eased sanctions in a deal that shocked Ukraine and its European allies.

data.title: Romania blames Russia for deadly attack on ship
data.description: BUCHAREST - Romania said on Friday one sailor had died and three were missing after a ship was struck by a drone and sank in the latest attack in the Black Sea that President Nicusor Dan blamed on Russia.

data.title: Asian football body makes U-turn, endorses Infantino
data.description: TOKYO - The head of Asian football said on Friday that the region supported Gianni Infantino’s bid for re-election as Fifa president, weeks after stinging criticism over his aborted World Cup sell-off plan.

data.title: ‘Fake’ pollsters exposed before US elections
data.description: WASHINGTON — A polling firm whose data was tracked by political campaigns and mainstream media has admitted that its polls were fabricated, in the second such scandal to stir controversy ahead of the midterm elections.

data.title: Israel-linked navigation app hits back at Malaysian claims
data.description: KUALA LUMPUR - The navigation app Waze has rejected Malaysia’s allegations that it could exploit users’ personal data, after the country banned civil servants from using the app over its Israeli links.

data.title: Floods persist in 16 provinces, two districts of Bangkok
data.description: Flooding has remained in 16 provinces and two Bangkok districts, affecting 375,726 households or 1.13 million people, with 64 deaths reported, according to the Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation (DDPM).

data.title: ‘Oldest friend in Asia’: Thailand and US celebrate ties over a rodeo bull
data.description: At the final stop of its Thailand-wide American Fair, the US ambassador says the real celebration is a friendship he calls America's oldest in Asia

data.title: Ukraine holds teen girl in Russian poison plot targeting soldiers
data.description: KYIV - Ukrainian police said on Friday that they had detained a 17-year-old girl suspected of helping Russia’s security services to poison Ukrainian soldiers and that two had died.

data.title: Lat Phrao road rage victim seeks help tracking attacker
data.description: A 27-year-old woman has vowed to pursue legal action to the fullest extent after a motorcyclist smashed her car windscreen and punched her in the face during a road rage incident at the Lat Phrao intersection in Bangkok.

data.title: ‘Call of Duty’ seeks to win back fans with warfare spectacle
data.description: The latest instalment in the “Call of Duty” video game franchise, arriving on Friday, brings back the high-adrenaline action that fuelled its success in an effort to revitalise a series that has been losing momentum.

data.title: ONE Championship releases five fighters, including Luo Chao and ‘Wondergirl’
data.description: ONE Championship has released five fighters from its roster, including Chinese kickboxer Luo Chao and Thai fighter Nat “Wondergirl” Jaroonsak, the Bangkok Post understands.

data.title: Floods persist in 16 provinces, two districts of Bangkok, affecting 1.13m people
data.description: Flooding has remained in 16 provinces and two Bangkok districts, affecting 375,726 households or 1.13 million people, with 64 deaths reported, according to the Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation (DDPM).

data.title: Bangkok arts festival generates over 250m baht after six-week run
data.description: Bangkok’s 28th International Festival of Dance & Music closed after presenting 12 productions from nine countries, with organisers reporting more than 250 million baht in economic activity.

data.title: Greece bans social media for under-15s
data.description: ATHENS - Greece's parliament passed a law on Friday banning children under 15 from social media, joining a growing number of countries imposing curbs on young people's use of the apps.

data.title: France braces for new protests as Macron seeks to restore order
data.description: PARIS - France is bracing for a weekend of new protests after some of the worst urban violence in years erupted on the sidelines of demonstrations a week ago, as President Emmanuel Macron sought to reclaim the initiative and restore order.

data.title: Speculation abounds on Trump-Kim meeting ahead of Apec summit
data.description: SEOUL - As world leaders prepare to gather in Shenzhen for November's Apec summit, speculation is mounting over a possible meeting between Donald Trump and Kim Jong Un—a prospect experts say remains remote.

data.title: How five Boeing 777s linked Madagascar’s power elite to Iran
data.description: JOHANNESBURG - Once among Madagascar’s most influential businessmen and a close ally of deposed president Andry Rajoelina, Mamy Ravatomanga stands at the centre of one of the island’s most explosive corruption cases.

data.title: Indonesia seizes 1.1 tonnes of ketamine at sea
data.description: Indonesian authorities have seized 1.1 tonnes of ketamine from a foreign vessel in Sumatran waters, the country’s second major drug bust in two months, a police official said on Friday.

data.title: West Bank attack wounds 5 as Israel PM cancels events
data.description: HEBRON (PALESTINIAN TERRITORIES) - An attack in the occupied West Bank wounded at least five Israelis on Friday and touched off a shootout that ended with two suspected Palestinian assailants dead, prompting Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to cancel political events days ahead of elections.

data.title: Guru's Weekly Buzz: Oct 23-29
data.description: Guru By Bangkok Post's weekly pick of the most exciting products, activities, food and travel to indulge in.

data.title: Actor Tom Skerritt, star of 'Alien' and 'Top Gun,' dies at 93
data.description: Versatile actor Tom ⁠Skerritt, who starred in Hollywood megahits, ​including the sci-fi classic Alien , the war comedy M*A*S*H , and the action drama Top Gun, has died at the age of 93.

data.title: South Korea proposes border talks with North
data.description: SEOUL - South Korea proposed military talks with North Korea on Friday to “mutually confirm the precise location” of their border and discuss restoring communication channels, after an explosion in the DMZ further strained relations.

data.title: Emergency nurseries rescue DR Congo's Ebola orphans
data.description: MONGBWALU (DR CONGO) - Caregivers at a nursery have had to don personal protection to feed and tend to hundreds of children orphaned by the Democratic Republic of Congo's Ebola outbreak.

data.title: Girl, 15, arrested waiting to hand over 4,000 meth tablets
data.description: KANCHANABURI - A 15-year-old girl has claimed she was waiting for a collector after being apprehended with a package of 4,000 methamphetamine pills in her sweatshirt on Thursday.

data.title: Young Thais favour value and energy savings over large homes
data.description: Homes priced at THB2.51–10 million made up 72% of expo bookings as Thailand’s homebuilders report growing demand for value and lower running costs.

data.title: Chinese woman wanted for B500m fraud arrested in Bangkok
data.description: A 36-year-old Chinese businesswoman wanted in her home country in a case involving customs violations that caused 500 million baht in damages, has been arrested at her condominium in the Sukhumvit area of Bangkok.

data.title: Indonesian fires threaten world’s oldest cave paintings
data.description: MAROS-PANGKEP, Indonesia - The ⁠world’s oldest cave ⁠paintings on the Indonesian ​island of Sulawesi are under threat as heat and smoke from the country’s worst ​wildfires in more than a decade ‌risk accelerating the deterioration of the more than 67,000-year-old works of art, researchers say.

data.title: Your weekly horoscope for Oct 23-29
data.description: Your spot-on weekly horoscope for work, money and relationships from Guru by Bangkok Post 's famously accurate fortune teller. Let's see how you will fare this week and beyond.

data.title: Thai GI ingredients shine at Michelin-starred Akkee
data.description: Thailand’s 219 GI food products are central to a premium market push, with selected ingredients showcased at Michelin-starred Akkee in Nonthaburi.

data.title: Thai Property Sector Tests Banks' Willingness Under New $1.5bn Housing Scheme
data.description: Ministers approve 50bn baht credit line for homes under 3m baht, but developers warn strict mortgage rejection rates could stall market recovery

data.title: DSI to review sedition complaint against poll-watchers
data.description: The Department of Special Investigation (DSI) will examine a complaint seeking sedition charges against eight activists accused of trying to decode ballot codes in a Bangkok by-election, according to the justice minister.

data.title: China’s first AI film hits cinemas but ticket sales lag
data.description: BEIJING - China’s first fully AI-generated feature film opens in cinemas on Friday, in what promises to be a tough box-office test for the country’s booming tech industry as advance ticket sales lag.

data.title: 50 teams deployed to probe toxic e-waste sites
data.description: Industry Minister Varawut Silpa-archa said he has deployed 50 teams to inspect 1,500 factories amid growing concerns of toxic electronic waste dumping.

data.title: Judge orders Trump to testify in BBC lawsuit
data.description: MIAMI - A US judge on Thursday issued President Donald Trump a December 11 deadline to testify under oath in his $10 billion defamation lawsuit against the BBC.

data.title: ‘Generational rage’: Young Europeans fight to be heard
data.description: ROME - From blockaded schools in Rome to tent camps in Madrid and street protests in France, young people across Europe are turning their anger on a political class they say is not listening.
